test_title: SSC CGL 2023 Tier-I Official Paper (Held On: 21 Jul 2023 Shift 2)
subject: general
question:
Select the most appropriate option that can substitute the underlined segment in the given sentence.

Hardly __we had boarded__ the train when it started to move.
solution:
The correct answer is "**had we boarded**".

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• If the second event occurs immediately after the first, we can express that idea using the structure: "hardly...when."
 
• In this structure hardly introduces the event that occurred first.
 
• The sentence is in past perfect tense, which requires the auxiliary verb "had".
 
• **When we begin a sentence with a negative word, we put the auxiliary verb before the subject.**
 
 
• **​Thus, "had" will be used before the subject "we."**
 
 
 
• "Hardly" is an adverb of time, indicating that the action of boarding the train happened just before another action (the train starting to move).
 
• The correct sentence structure is "Hardly had we boarded the train when it started to move."

Hence, **the correct answer is option 4**.
